description: Check every tool in a tools/list result or a server card. Returns per-tool findings plus duplicate-name, overlapping-descriptions, and too-many-tools. Those three omit resource. Does not store the tools.

result.description: JSON-RPC tools/list result. Used only when tools is omitted. The array is result.tools.

tools.description: Tools from a tools/list result or a server card. Each item has name, description, and inputSchema.

name: check_server
title: Check a tools/list result
